violations.policy_section: Retail agent policy > Modify pending order > Modify items
violations.policy_clause: This action can only be called once, and will change the order status to 'pending (items modifed)'. The agent will not be able to modify or cancel the order anymore. So you must confirm all the details are correct and be cautious before taking this action.

violations.reason: The agent invoked modify_pending_order_items at step 17, which the policy identifies as the one-time action after which the order can no longer be modified or cancelled. It nevertheless proceeded to call modify_pending_order_payment (steps 18 and 27) and modify_pending_order_address (step 19), attempting further modifications to the same order after taking that locking item-modification action.
